title: Plan for Testing Fingerstick Bloods on Magellan Systems
brief_summary: This study is to supplement our internal data that demonstrates the continued performance of capillary blood samples on Magellan's lead testing systems: LeadCare II, LeadCare Ultra (which have been cleared previously by FDA), and PediaStat, which is an upgraded LeadCare II instrument in development.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* healthy subjects who consent to a capillary blood collection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients are not currently taking chelating agents, e.g., penicillamine, succimer
study_population: adults and children up to 18 years of age who are at risk of lead exposure, pregnant women who are at risk of lead exposure,
